  about "Acknowledge a new ticket and remind about the service center"
  policy RepairPolicy

}

procedure FoodBankReorder {
  about "Reorder canned goods based on the list"
  policy FoodBankPolicy
  sheet Prices "Prices" { item: Text, case_price: Money }
  trigger every monday at 10:00

  let all = fetch Prices
  let these = filter all where item == "canned goods"
  let n = summarize count of these
  if n == 0 {
    stop "no canned goods listed"
  }
  let r = find these where case_price == $0.00 else stop "case price is zero"
  order "100 cases of canned goods" from "Valley Wholesale" cost r.case_price * 100, ask owner first timeout 12 hours else stop "order not approved"
  log "ordered {r.case_price * 100}"
}
